card.title: I’ve Done This Before
card.instruction: Perform calm familiarity with the task while learning how it works from every new clue.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll make your coffee. I know this machine: this button starts it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: That's steam. The coffee button is behind the flap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. Steam first, then the concealed coffee controls. Where's your cup?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Here. It makes two cups unless you turn that dial.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course. Dial to one. I always tailor the standard procedure to the guest.

mechanism: A maintains calm machine familiarity while incorporating B's instructions into a supposedly known procedure.
confusable: Unlike openly being taught, each new clue must appear in A's next competent-sounding action without admitting discovery.
comparison: D42-a uses hidden controls and a quantity dial; D42-b uses clips and inner-tent identification.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
